enabled.label: query
enabled.description: Whether to enable or disable receive mode

endpoint.label: query
endpoint.description: Endpoint for where to receive messages (can also refer to a route id, endpoint pattern)

messages.description: The dumped received messages, as opaque JSON objects (only present when dumping)

enabled.description: Whether receiving is enabled (only present when not dumping)

total.description: Total number of messages received so far (only present when not dumping)

firstTimestamp.description: Epoch time in milliseconds of the first message in the last dump (only present when not dumping)

lastTimestamp.description: Epoch time in milliseconds of the last message in the last dump (only present when not dumping)

url.description: The endpoint URI that receiving was started for (only present on success)

error.description: The error message (only present on failure to start receiving)

stackTrace.description: The error stack trace, one entry per line (only present on failure to start receiving)

endpoints.description: The active consumer endpoints (only present when not dumping and there are any)
